name: SearchBlox
tagline: Packaged enterprise search and RAG platform built on OpenSearch, with crawlers, connectors and hybrid search.
description: SearchBlox is a commercial enterprise search product, around since 2003, that packages an OpenSearch-based index with web crawlers, hundreds of content connectors (SharePoint, Confluence, S3, databases and more), relevance tuning, facets and a search UI, so teams get site or intranet search without assembling an Elasticsearch stack themselves. Its current release, SearchAI 12, layers hybrid keyword-plus-vector search, retrieval-augmented chat, assistants, private LLM hosting and auto-generated FAQs and synonyms on the same index, exposed through REST APIs. It installs on Windows or Linux, in Docker or on major clouds, with a fixed annual price rather than per-query fees. Choose it for turnkey enterprise or e-commerce search; it is not a general-purpose datastore.

pricing.notes: Fixed annual pricing with no per-query or token fees; a free download is offered for evaluation.

scale.notes: Scales with the underlying OpenSearch cluster, including Amazon OpenSearch Service.

strengths: Turnkey crawlers and 300+ connectors for intranet, site and e-commerce search
Hybrid keyword and vector search plus RAG chat on one index
Runs on-premises, in your cloud or fully managed
weaknesses: Proprietary layer over OpenSearch, with a smaller community than either OpenSearch or Elasticsearch
Not a general-purpose database for application data
Advanced tuning ultimately requires understanding OpenSearch internals
useCases: Search over SharePoint, Confluence and cloud storage
notIdealFor: Teams wanting an open-source search engine to build on directly
